summary: AI labels on every social (0.37.1): every video starts labeled as AI-made (uploads too, which Nate can turn off); videos the app made (video source, series part, text editor) are always labeled and their checkbox is locked on. Posting windows already set TikTok's AI-generated content and YouTube's altered content; they now also turn on Instagram's and Facebook's AI label switch (with a reminder in the panel if the switch isn't found), X posts get #AIgenerated in the text, and Instagram/Facebook API posts get #AIgenerated since the API has no label.

spots.note: DEFAULT_DETAILS.madeWithAi true, madeInApp, detailsOf forces the label, AI_TAG/TEXT_LABEL_SOCIALS and postText(video, platform, labelInText)
postRequest passes the platform to postText so X gets #AIgenerated
Made with AI checkbox locked on for in-app videos; uploads start labeled
POST_SCRIPT labelOn for Instagram (Advanced settings > Add AI label) and Facebook; reminders for a missing label and YouTube altered content
